title: 10-Year TIPS auction (second and final reopening of CUSIP 91282CRE3) — the last real-yield primary print of 2026
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), re-fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) by this event's own initial research and its text layer decompressed stream-by-stream, then re-tokenised into 213 (security, announce, auction, settle) rows. The row reads verbatim `10-Year TIPS R T / Announcement Thursday, November 12, 2026 / Auction Thursday, November 19, 2026 / Settlement Monday, November 30, 2026`, where Treasury's trailing `R` marks a reopening and `T` marks TIPS. 1:00pm ET is Treasury's standing coupon-auction convention and is NOT separately sourced. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN never-assessed INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-08), which read `proposals/treasury-10y-tips-2026-11-19.from-treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-11-12.json` in full first per EVENT-RESEARCH.md. Ledger: docs/research/events/treasury-10y-tips-2026-11-19.md. THE SIZE BASE RATE IS STRONGER THAN THE PROPOSAL RECORDED, and re-derived here from a wider pull (fiscaldata auctions_query, `inflation_index_security: Yes`, back to 2019-01-01, n=46 on the 10-Year leg): reopenings print EXACTLY $2B below their own CUSIP's new issue in 30 of 30 cases across 15 fully-reopened CUSIPs and eight years, and the second reopening equals the first in 15 of 15 — not the 14/14 and 7/7 the proposal carried from a 2023-only window. 91282CRE3 sold as a $21B new issue 2026-07-23 (high yield 2.438% real, bid-to-cover 2.30), so $19B. THE CYCLE IS ALSO WIDER THAN RECORDED: the 10-Year TIPS series runs TWO new issues a year (January and July), each reopened exactly twice — Jan -> Mar + May, Jul -> Sep + Nov, 15 of 15 since 2019 — so this is the `9-Year 8-Month` November slot. CUSIP 91282CRE3 remains an INFERENCE, not a fetched field: treasurydirect's TA_WS/securities/upcoming feed was pulled this session (HTTP 200) and returns 10 rows reaching only 2026-09-17, where it does confirm 91282CRE3 as that date's `9-Year 10-Month` reopening. THE TERMINAL-SALE FINDING: the same schedule carries `10-Year TIPS T` — no `R`, a NEW ISSUE — announced 2027-01-14 and auctioned 2027-01-21, so 2026-11-19 is the last time 91282CRE3 is ever sold and the last 10Y real-yield primary print of 2026. That also puts a Treasury-primary DATE on the sibling treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-11-12 ledger's asymmetry finding (a TIPS size change has only ever expressed at a new issue): the next place it can express is 2027-01-21, proposed in the same PR. THE SESSION FINDING: 2026-11-19 is simultaneously a Treasury ANNOUNCEMENT day — the schedule announces eight securities that morning (2-Year note, 5-Year note, 7-Year note, 2-Year FRN reopening, 52-week bill, 13/26/6-week bills) covering the entire Thanksgiving-week coupon block, ~11:00 ET, two hours before this auction's 1:00pm bidding deadline. Measured and NOT a Veterans Day artifact: the 2-Year note's announcement has shared the session with the 10Y TIPS November second reopening in 6 of 7 years since 2019 (the exception is 2023, one day apart), and 2026 makes 7 of 8. Read-it-do-not-trade-it: `symbols: []`, the date is `estimate`, and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed. Sits in the quietest Fed window of the quarter — 22 days after fomc-2026-10-28, 20 days before fomc-2026-12-09, and 9 days before fomc-blackout-start-2026-11-28 — which is the sharpest contrast with its own first reopening (treasury-10y-tips-2026-09-17), that one priced D+1 to an FOMC decision.
